item.title: Bridges & Brunch with Strasburg Scooter Tours — Sun Sep 13 — Strasburg Scooter Tours
item.description:
Experience a relaxing morning ride through the back roads of Amish Country in Lancaster County, PA. Along the way to a 19th century covered bridge, enjoy the scenery of rolling hills, breathtaking views, and our Amish neighbors going about their daily routines. Itinerary Duration: 1.5-2 hours Some of our past tours have included:
A guided tour of one of Lancaster County’s most beautiful covered bridges An opportunity for a close up of daily life in Amish Country $10 dining voucher to one of two of Strasburg’s favorites brunch spots, Casey Jones’ Restaurant and Speckled Hen*
And each trip is unique, so you never know what we might have in store for you! *Unfortunately, we regret to inform you that some of the food offerings on the tour may not be considered ‘Kosher.’ We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: The Denver Fair — Tue Sep 15 — Denver Memorial Park
item.description:
The Denver Fair is a vibrant, five-day community tradition held annually in mid-September at Denver Memorial Park in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania. Established in 1981 by local volunteers, this non-profit event has maintained free admission since 1983, attracting over 40,000 visitors. The fair celebrates the region’s agricultural roots with livestock shows, competitive exhibits for baked goods, and unique contests like hot wing eating or the baby parade. Families can enjoy a bustling midway featuring nearly 30 amusement rides, classic fair foods, and free nightly entertainment. The festivities traditionally conclude on Saturday night with a grand fireworks display. The 2026 Denver Fair is scheduled for September 15 – 19.

item.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour — Tue Sep 15, 9:00 AM — Unique Lancaster
item.description:
Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally!
Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century.
Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI.
But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region.

item.title: ZZ Top at American Music Theatre — Tue Sep 15, 7:30 PM — American Music Theatre
item.description: ZZ Top: The Big One Rock legends ZZ Top have been delivering their signature blend of blues, boogie, and hard rock for over half a century. Formed in Houston in 1969 by Billy Gibbons, Dusty Hill, and Frank Beard, the band rose to national prominence with Tres Hombres and the enduring hit “La Grange,” before reaching global superstardom with 1983’s Eliminator and iconic tracks like “Sharp Dressed Man” and “Legs.” Famed for their unmistakable look – long beards, hot rods, and spinning guitars – ZZ Top became one of MTV’s defining acts while staying true to their deep blues roots. Their influences span legends like Muddy Waters, B.B. King, and Jimi Hendrix, shaping a sound that is both timeless and instantly recognizable. With millions of records sold, decades of worldwide touring, and an induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame by Keith Richards, ZZ Top remains one of the most enduring forces in rock. item.title: Solanco Fair — Wed Sep 16 — Solanco Fair
item.description:
The Solanco Fair, a beloved tradition in southern Lancaster County, captures the “wholesome atmosphere” envisioned by its founders in 1950. Born from the initiative of local farm women and agricultural groups, the fair remains a steadfast celebration of rural life and community fellowship. Held annually in Quarryville, the event is renowned for its parade, iron-lung-defying food like pit poultry, and high-quality livestock exhibits. Visitors can browse diverse competitive displays featuring needlework, baking, and homegrown produce. This three-day September gathering stays true to its roots, offering a family-friendly environment where agricultural heritage and friendly competition take center stage.

item.description:
Nashville native Riley Clemmons is an accomplished composer, performer, producer and recording artist who has made her mark on the contemporary Christian music scene. Her breakout single “Broken Prayers” came in 2017, followed by her self-titled album debut, which quickly entered the Billboard Heatseekers chart.
Clemmons’ single “Fighting For Me” earned RIAA Gold Certification, adding to recognition from Rolling Stone and People Magazine along with Dove and K-LOVE award nominations. Clemmons has brought her music to some of the biggest stages and platforms around, from the “TODAY” Show and “FOX & Friends” to a landmark debut at the Grand Ole Opry. Drawing from real life and a wide range of musical influences, she crafts songs that are as emotionally honest as they are catchy, resonating with listeners beyond any single genre.

item.title: Evening Compline — Thu Sep 17, 9:00 PM — Saint James Episcopal Church
item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.

item.title: PA 211 Resource Table — Thu Dec 10, 9:00 AM — Lancaster
item.description:
Community, Everyone
PA 211 staff will provide easily accessible walk-up assistance in the library's front lobby. Assistance includes information and referrals for a broad range of services: childcare, after-school programs, food banks, elder care, basic needs, health services, and more. item.title: Color & Chill — Thu Dec 10, 10:00 AM — Manheim Township
item.description:
Arts & Crafts, Community, Adults, Seniors
The Sensory Social is getting a low-key summer remix! Drop in for a relaxing hour of coloring, lo-fi beats, and calm lighting.This is a self-guided, community-wide lounge where everyone is welcome to relax, keep their hands busy, and create at their own pace. Our space is intentionally designed to be sensory-friendly, fully accessible, and inclusive for all adults, including individuals with IDD, autism, and their support people.We provide a variety of intricate coloring pages, high-quality markers, and pens, but feel free to bring your own favorite supplies if you prefer! Come as you are, bring a friend, and just zone out and chill.
Source: Lancaster Libraries
